number_format: Inputs are binary64 ('binary64' shortest round trip, 'hex', 'exact' rational). Derived reals are decimal strings with 40 significant digits and the nearest binary64. rel_dev and cross-check residuals are short diagnostics. SI units.
model: pipe along X, fully fixed at A, only UZ restrained at the tip B

section.premises: no contents, no insulation, no allowances; I = pi(OD^4 - ID^4)/64; mbar = rho A; ibar = rho I; J = 2I, jbar = rho J

periodic_rule: the first six modes of the model's merged ascending list (all finite modes where fewer exist), no missing-mass correction; axial and torsional modes count in the list but contribute zero
sign_conventions:
UY, UZ, FY, FZ along the axes; MZ is
conjugate to RZ = dUY/dX; MY is conjugate to RY = -dUZ/dX, so MY = -M0 of the
planar XZ problem. Reactions are the forces the supports apply to the pipe.
rules: SRSS; ABSSUM (the absolute sum); TEN_PERCENT (the ten percent method: every pair i < j with (f_j - f_i)/f_i <= 0.1): modal rules of DEL-04-10 CLM-001. No two modes of these models lie within DEL-04-09's cluster tolerance, so no cluster is summed first (CLM-001, Repeated modes)
deviation_basis: rel_dev against the Rayleigh continuum with its first six merged modes periodic (the case as defined); per-mode values against the continuum mode of the same plane and index

truncation.definition: first two merged modes periodic (Y1 and Z1), correction on, f_r = 1.25 Hz, FLAT (a_r = 2.5 m/s^2). The rigid part of direction k is the static response to a_r (M R_k - Gamma_1k M phi_1) over all DOFs; it is combined with the single periodic contribution by SRSS and by absolute sum. Lumped: the rigid load is formed on all DOFs, restrained ones included; a restrained translation's lumped mass (mbar h/2) is absent from the modes but present in the total mass, so it enters the rigid load at its restrained DOF and reacts there directly (K_cf u - F_c). The total reaction check confirms that the rigid reactions balance a_r times (total mass - periodic effective mass)

cross_checks.what: N = 8 consistent: first six merged frequencies against discrete/c8_pipe_x.json frequency_list
N = 8 consistent: signed per-mode contributions of the seven quantities under FLAT and TWO (linear-linear) against the sibling's C8-I-FLAT and C8-II-TWO-LL
N = 8 consistent: rigid response per unit rigid acceleration (periodic Y1, Z1, f_r = 1.25 Hz) against the sibling's C8-III-TRUNCATION rigid_response_signed scaled by its a_r = 3.5 m/s^2
every compared signed value has the sibling's sign
continuum per mode: total reaction = -effective mass
Euler-Bernoulli roots: determinant against cos cosh = -1 and tan = tanh
static coefficients against qL^4/8EI, qL^4/192EI and the end reactions
FE eigenvalues: Jacobi against Sturm bisection (40 digits)
FE per mode: total reaction = -effective mass
FE rigid displacement against the non-periodic modes' Gamma phi / lam
rigid reactions = -a_r (total mass - periodic effective mass), all formulations
axial and torsional rod frequencies bracketed by Sturm counts
FE: modes built per family equal the formulation's count (consistent 6N - 1, lumped 3N - 1), and the merged list holds all of them
continuum: the first mode not built of every family lies above the 12th listed frequency, so first_modes is the true first 12
continuum: the list's first five bending frequencies per plane are identical to those of the modes the responses use
smallest relative eigenvalue gap between adjacent modes of every merged list exceeds DEL-04-09's cluster tolerance 2^-20, so no cluster is summed first
